title: Jukebox
description: A close look into the glass dome of a 1950s jukebox, twenty 45s standing in chrome cradles. Punch a code and the carousel ratchets round, the gripper lays the record on the platter and the needle drops; punch another mid-way and the whole rig turns around without a snap.
intent: One real mechanism finished to the edge: a select-o-matic carousel, gripper, platter and tone arm that are all driven by one interruptible plan, so every code you punch is answered by chrome and vinyl actually moving.
